relationships.subject: PD98059
relationships.evidence_quote: MEK/ERK inhibition with intrathecal PD98059 reversed perineural tumor-induced mechanical allodynia.

key_findings: Perineural prostate cancer injection produces M1 macrophage infiltration, cytokine and neuronal injury marker upregulation, and progressive hyperalgesia.
Intrathecal MEK/ERK inhibition reverses tumor-induced mechanical allodynia.
